text:
[Council File 26-1232]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the creation of a new additional re-inspection fee for Certified Unified Program Agency (CUPA) regulated programs.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the creation of an additional re-inspection fee, and add the new fee to the Los Angeles Fire Department's Cost of Special Services for CUPA Programs.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Fire Commissioners reports that, assuming the recommended fee becomes effective July 1, 2026, it is projected to generate approximately $46,890.50 in revenue in Fiscal Year 2026-27, based on 122.75 hours of additional re- inspections recorded in Fiscal Year 2024-25. The fee will be based on the inspector hourly rate at the time of adoption, charged per hour or fraction thereof, with a one- hour minimum. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
